## Example Usage - Contact Center Insights Assessment Rule Full


```hcl
resource "google_contact_center_insights_assessment_rule" "assessment_rule_full" {
  location = "us-central1"
  display_name = "assessment-rule-display-name"
  conversation_filter = "agent_id = \"1\""
  sample_rule {
    sample_row = 5
  }
  schedule_info {
    schedule_info = "every 24 hours"
  }
  active    = true
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

* `assessment_rule_id` -
  (Required)
  A unique ID for the new AssessmentRule. This ID will become the final
  component of the AssessmentRule's resource name. If no ID is specified,
  a server-generated ID will be used.
  This value should be 4-64 characters and must match the regular
  expression `^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`.


* `active` -
  (Optional)
  If true, apply this rule to conversations. Otherwise, this rule is
  inactive.

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display Name of the assessment rule.

* `sample_rule` -
  (Optional)
  Message for sampling conversations.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_sample_rule).

* `schedule_info` -
  (Optional)
  Message for schedule info.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_schedule_info).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.



<a name="nested_sample_rule"></a>The `sample_rule` block supports:

* `conversation_filter` -
  (Optional)
  To specify the filter for the conversions that should apply this sample
  rule. An empty filter means this sample rule applies to all conversations.

* `dimension` -
  (Optional)
  Group by dimension to sample the conversation. If no dimension is
  provided, the sampling will be applied to the project level.
  Current supported dimensions is 'quality_metadata.agent_info.agent_id'.

* `sample_percentage` -
  (Optional)
  Percentage of conversations that we should sample  based on the dimension
  between [0, 100].

* `sample_row` -
  (Optional)
  Number of the conversations that we should sample based on the dimension.

<a name="nested_schedule_info"></a>The `schedule_info` block supports:

* `end_time` -
  (Optional)
  End time of the schedule. If not specified, will keep scheduling new
  pipelines for execution util the schedule is no longer active or deleted.

* `schedule` -
  (Optional)
  The groc expression.
  Format: `every number [synchronized]`
  Time units can be: minutes, hours
  Synchronized is optional and indicates that the schedule should be
  synchronized to the start of the interval: every 5 minutes synchronized
  means 00:00, 00:05 ...
  Otherwise the start time is random within the interval.
  Example: `every 5 minutes`
  could be  00:02, 00:07, 00:12, ...

* `start_time` -
  (Optional)
  Start time of the schedule. If not specified, will start as soon as the
  schedule is created.

* `time_zone` -
  (Optional)
  The timezone to use for the groc expression.
  If not specified, defaults to UTC.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/assessmentRules/{{assessment_rule_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which this assessment rule was created.

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name of the assessment rule.
  Format:
  projects/{project}/locations/{location}/assessmentRules/{assessment_rule}

* `update_time` -
  The most recent time at which this assessment rule was updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


AssessmentRule can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/assessmentRules/{{assessment_rule_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{assessment_rule_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{assessment_rule_id}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import AssessmentRule using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/assessmentRules/{{assessment_rule_id}}"
  to = google_contact_center_insights_assessment_rule.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), AssessmentRule can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_assessment_rule.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/assessmentRules/{{assessment_rule_id}}
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_assessment_rule.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{assessment_rule_id}}
$ terraform import google_contact_center_insights_assessment_rule.default {{location}}/{{assessment_rule_id}}
```
